title: Ericksen Universal Deformations of Incompressible Solids
exact_target: Classify every universal deformation whose principal invariants remain constant throughout the incompressible isotropic solid.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005837 (OWR-14298167-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mechanics of Materials: Multiscale Design of Advanced Materials and Structures (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/11, pp. 657--730. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: Constant principal invariants do not mean that $F$ itself is spatially constant. The target includes possible nonaffine deformations.
